children: Nova Minerals received ~500 tons of processing and refining equipment in Port MacKenzie to advance its antimony facility.
About 500 tons of equipment arrived at Port MacKenzie, including crushing, milling, flotation and refining gear.
Shipment funded by a US$43.4 million award from the Department of War under Title III of the Defense Production Act.
Delivery accelerates construction timetable and supports target to commence antimony production in 2027.
Modular Port MacKenzie facility initially to produce antimony trisulfide with potential to expand to metal and trioxide.
Location offers year-round deepwater port and rail/road access to support domestic supply chain development.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Nova Minerals advances antimony project as 500 tons of processing equipment arrive in Alaska
